description: Land  Title Settlement Department  -Weligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District  - Cad. Map No. 320236
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, identity card numbers, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
